messages:
sam_sales: FYI - ACME signed off on a POC but they insist on a private deploy. Need quick checklist for network handoff: PrivateLink vs VPC Peering, subnet CIDR suggestions, route table changes, NAT/egress, DNS, and who owns the infra work. Any known enterprise blockers?

anya_se: quick clarifying q - do they want a customer-managed VPC + peering/Transit, or an interface endpoint into our service (PrivateLink)? their security doc mentions 'no internet egress for API traffic' so sounds like PrivateLink/VPCE preferred.

ev an_se: (typo fixed) They wrote "no internet egress" — PrivateLink (interface endpoints) is the safer bet for cross-account restricted traffic. VPCE vs Peering tradeoffs below.

raj_network: Short tradeoff summary: 
- VPC Peering / TGW: full L3 routing; requires route table updates on both sides and possible TGW for many accounts; transitive routing limits. Good if they need wide network access.
- PrivateLink (Interface Endpoint): we front an NLB in our account, they create ENIs in their subnets that talk to the NLB. No route table changes other than ENIs. Better isolation and simpler security posture for POC.

raj_network: Subnet sizing suggestion for a short POC: give each environment (non-prod/prod) a /22 split across AZs so interface endpoints have space for ENIs. Example template: 
`10.40.0.0/22` non-prod (AZ subnets: 10.40.0.0/24, 10.40.1.0/24, 10.40.2.0/24)
`10.40.4.0/22` prod
If they have existing CIDR constraints we can adapt.

anya_se: Also call out certs & TLS: for PrivateLink we usually terminate TLS on the NLB. We can use ACM certs in our account or they can supply certs. If they require mutual TLS, we need to confirm before provisioning.

ev an_se: POC action checklist for sales/solutions: 
1) Confirm connectivity method (PrivateLink vs Peering)
2) Customer provides target subnet CIDRs + AZ mapping
3) Confirm allowed source CIDRs or SG requirements for the NLB
4) Decide on TLS vs mTLS and cert ownership
5) Provide an IAM principal or token (role) we can use for any cross-account provisioning steps if allowed
6) Throughput/latency expectations for sizing

sam_sales: They want the demo next Thu. Can infra spin up the NLB + target group for PrivateLink and we hand over details to ACME? Who picks this up?

infra-bot: deploy-bot: Ticket created: NET-4823 "PrivateLink POC - ACME" assigned -> @raj_network. ETA 2 business days. Reference: internal runbook `docs/network/private-link-runbook` (note: internal link).

raj_network: I'll start NLB + SG + target group prep. Need the list of allowed source CIDRs (their side) and whether they want mTLS. If we do mTLS we'll need client certs or use TLS + SG filtering.

acme_network_admin: acme_network_admin: we'll share CIDRs by EOD and confirm mTLS requirement. For now assume mTLS = yes, and we will provide public CA details. Also confirm we want DNS resolving `api.redwood.acme.internal` to the endpoint.

anya_se: DNS note: For PrivateLink you can either provide private hosted zone instructions (they create a hosted zone and add A records to endpoint ENIs) or we can set up a conditional private hosted zone in their account. We'll provide clear steps.

ev an_se: Quick routing config note for peering (if they choose peering): 
```
# on customer route table
Destination: 10.40.0.0/22 -> Target: vpc-peering-0abc12345
```
For PrivateLink no route table changes are required — only ENIs show up in the subnet.

raj_network: Security groups we plan: 
- NLB SG: allow inbound 443 from customer CIDRs only
- Service SG: allow from NLB SG
Also ensure NACLs don't block ENI traffic.

sam_sales: Perfect — I'll collect CIDRs + confirm mTLS today and drop here. Will loop back with ACME contact. :thumbsup:

anya_se: I'll prepare a one-pager with steps for customer infra team (PrivateLink vs Peering pros/cons, DNS steps, minimal CIDR example, timeframe). Will post here when ready.

raj_network: started infra prep, will post exact NLB listener config and SG rules once ticket updated.

sam_sales: Thanks team. Need any pricing notes for Dedicated pool vs Hosted for a private POC? ACME asked about Dedicated overhead.

ev an_se: For POC we recommend Hosted + PrivateLink to validate integration. If they need sustained throughput we can estimate Dedicated pool sizing after seeing token throughput from POC. I'll prepare ballpark numbers.

sam_sales: Awesome, keeping this thread as the single source for handoff.
